item.title: [−1] Rabi sowing at 178.25 lakh hectares by 13 November, 11.34% behind last year; wheat down 15.28%
item.description:
Wheat covers 50.07 lakh hectares, pulses 47 lakh (down 14.34%) and mustard 59.31 lakh (down 8.45%). The gap has narrowed from 17.21% a week earlier and 46% on 30 October. Easing but still behind.

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — Sowing still behind

Why it matters: Lagging winter sowing threatens wheat, pulses and oilseed output just as food inflation runs near 9%, though the shortfall is closing as planting catches up.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] UN urges the US and Iran to let fertiliser shipments through the Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
The appeal comes as rabi sowing lags and days after India raised its winter fertiliser subsidy 64% to ₹62,370 crore on higher global prices. New.

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — Fertiliser supply and cost risk

Why it matters: Gulf suppliers ship much of India's urea, ammonia and LNG feedstock; blocked cargoes raise prices and the subsidy bill during the sowing season.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
